The '''IX4 laser cannon''' was a model of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] manufactured by [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]]. The [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] were installed on [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing's]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]].<ref name="SWS" />
